About

I'm a software engineer with an M.S. in Computer Science from East Carolina University. I build across the stack, from backend services and web apps to data, cloud and low-level systems, and I pick up whatever a project needs.

I build with AI tooling, including coding agents and LLM integrations, and I've written my own tools to keep agents reliable. I start from requirements, design before I code, and test against what the software is supposed to do.
